settings.intro: World in Common is built in public. You do not need to be part of an organisation, have a platform, or agree with every idea here to contribute.

settings.heading: Send us
settings.text:
• a book, article, essay, or video we should read
  • a subject or problem you think we should explore
  • a community, project, or organisation we should know about
  • a solution that is already working somewhere
  • a story or example from your own life
  • a T-shirt idea or design you think belongs here
  • an open-source tool, project, or collaboration we should feature
  • a correction when we have misunderstood something

Teach us something new. Challenge an assumption. Send us a design. Point us toward a problem we have missed.

settings.heading: Built in public
settings.text: This is not a finished brand handing down a finished worldview. It is an open contribution project. The more people who add knowledge, criticism, creativity, and lived experience, the more useful it can become.

settings.heading: Send something
settings.text:
Use the contact form and tell us what you are sending and why you think it belongs here.

For reading recommendations, include the title, author, link, and what you found valuable or challenging. For designs, include a short explanation of the idea and whether you created the work yourself.

We cannot promise to use or publish everything. We will not claim ownership of your work simply because you send it to us, and we will ask before using a contribution commercially. Please do not send work you do not have permission to share.
